title: SAP-Pentest sandbox profile
description: Per-category bwrap sandbox descriptor consumed by core/sandbox.py. Each MCP server selects a profile by name (recon, exploit, osint, blueteam, parrot, engagement); core.sandbox.wrap() composes the bwrap command line from these fields.

name.description: Profile identifier. Must match the JSON filename (without extension).

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this profile allows and why.

bind_ro.description: Host paths exposed read-only inside the sandbox. Typically /usr /etc /lib /bin so the tool can run.

bind_rw.description: Extra read-write mounts as [host_path, sandbox_path] pairs. Use sparingly: the workdir is the standard RW path.

workdir_template.description: Format-string for the per-run workdir on the HOST. {run_id} is interpolated. Created at spawn time. Example: "/tmp/sap-{run_id}/recon".

workdir_mount.description: Path INSIDE the sandbox where the workdir is mounted RW. Default: /work.

tmpfs.description: Paths mounted as tmpfs (in-memory, scrubbed at exit). Default: ["/tmp"].

as_pid_1.description: Make the tool PID 1 in the sandbox (death-with-parent).

unshare_user.description: Allocate a new user namespace (maps the caller UID to 0 inside).

unshare_uts.description: Allocate a new UTS namespace (isolated hostname).

network_policy.description: Network egress policy. "in_scope" leaves the host network attached (filtering remains the scope_validator's job). "domain_allowlist" same as in_scope for v2.3 but reserved for future nftables-based filtering. "none" applies --unshare-net for full isolation.

caps_drop.description: Linux capabilities dropped before exec. Default policy is ["ALL"]; add explicit caps via caps_keep.

caps_keep.description: Capabilities kept despite caps_drop. Example: ["CAP_NET_RAW", "CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE"] for nmap SYN scans.

seccomp_filter.description: Path to a precompiled seccomp BPF blob. Reserved for v2.4.
